description: The user's own recent norms to judge a day against: the band of the last `days` days (default 28, ending the day BEFORE `date`) for sleepDurationS, sleepScore, hrv, recoveryMorning, recoveryLow (Balance x100 = the watch's Resources %) and steps. Sleep values come from the main sleep that led INTO each day (under about 3 h is a nap, not counted). A day without data has no value, never 0. Per metric: n, median, p25, p75 (null when n < 7), last7Median, latest (null when missing, and always for steps and recoveryLow), latestVsBand (below | within | above). The band is the user's own middle half, not a medical reference. A failing section leaves its metrics empty and is listed in errors.

date.description: Local day YYYY-MM-DD being judged. Today may be incomplete.

name: get_baselines
title: Get personal baselines (sleep, HRV, recovery, steps)
